text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Wild, overwhelming--the strongest run. 
Showing that strength to the full, 
Duramente avenged her loss in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Her running was so commanding that even the horsegirls 
who ran alongside her acknowledged it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
When we returned to the waiting room, her family 
greeted her with loud applause.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Before them all, Duramente spoke. 
Next, to the world--she would take on the Arc de Triomphe.
